summary: Implementation plan for adding a WordPress/Yoast-style Bulk SEO Editor view inside the Admin Panel's SEO & Ranking Management Suite, featuring an interactive data grid of all pages with inline editing for Title, Meta Description, Focus Keyword, and Indexing Toggle, live character counters & progress bars, real-time Yoast SEO score calculation, search/status filtering, and one-click deep links to the full SERP editor.
